Name: Elle's Town Buildings
Author: junimods
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/n4XdwZb.png[/img]

- Replaces all the buildings around Pelican Town:
﻿- Clint's Blacksmith Shop
﻿- Harvey's clinic
﻿- Marnie's Ranch
﻿- Jojamart and the Movie Theatre
﻿- Pierre's General Store
﻿- Robin's Carpenter Shop
﻿- Stardrop Saloon
﻿- The Adventurer Guild
﻿- The Bathhouse
﻿- The Hat Mouse's Shop
﻿- The Library/Museum
﻿- The Oasis Shop
﻿- Willy's Fish Shop
﻿- Alex, George, & Evelyn's house
﻿- Emily & Haley's house
﻿- Elliot's house
﻿- Leah's House
﻿- Linus's Tent
﻿- Mayor Lewis's house
﻿- Pam & Penny's trailer
﻿- Pam & Penny's upgraded house
﻿- Sam, Vincent, Jodi, and Kent's house
﻿- The Witch's hut
﻿- The Wizard's tower
﻿- Dusty's upgraded dog house
﻿- The bus
﻿- The railroad station
- Adds buildings to the in-game map
- Currently includes four palettes:
﻿1) 'Elle' for the vanilla map
2) 'Earthy' for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿
        3) 'Starblue' for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]strangelyliteral's Starblue Valley
[/url]        4) 'Wittily' for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995]acerbicon's A Wittily Named Recolor[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ad9prRZ.png[/img]﻿

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
3. Unzip/extract the[b][color=#f6b26b] [CP] Elle's Town Buildings[/color][/b] folder into your [b]\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/b] folder.
4. (Optional) Run the game once with SMAPI to generate a [b]config.json[/b].
5. (Optional) Open the config.json with a program like Notepad and disable any building retexture you don't want by changing [font=Courier New][color=#e69138]true[/color][/font] to [font=Courier New][color=#e69138]false[/color][/font]. You may also choose [font=Courier New][color=#f6b26b]Elle[/color][/font], [font=Courier New][color=#f6b26b]Earthy[/color][/font], [font=Courier New][color=#f6b26b]Starblue[/color][/font], or [font=Courier New][color=#f6b26b]Wittily[/color][/font] currently for the "Palette" option. If you can't get a config.json to generate, you can rename the example_config.json to config.json and use it instead.
6. Run the game using SMAPI to play!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hxvaHeU.png[/img]﻿

1.0.4 - Updated map building icons for 1.6
         - Edited and removed some of the new 1.6 building shadows (tested on vanilla maps only, so let me know if there are issues with any mods)
         - Fixed the Oasis not being edited if map icons are turned off
         - Added dependencies for VPR Temp Fix and Hueless Haven
1.0.3 - Added 'Wittily' palette
1.0.2 - Added 'Starblue' palette
         - Added buildings to in-game map (with 'Map Buildings' config option)
         - Changed the Carpenter Shop to accommodate Sebastian's 4 heart event
         - Fixed the bus when the farmer uses a desert totem and drives back to town
         - Lots of tiny texture fixes
         - Added dependency for VPR for compatibility
1.0.1 - Added 'Earthy' palette
         - Fixed Willy's shop during the Night Market
         - Fixed weirdness with Linus's tent
         - Tiny fixes on several buildings
